articleTitle: Navigating the Effectiveness of Various M L Algorithms for Myocardial Infarction Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: A comprehensive analysis has been initiated using the ECG Heartbeat Categorization Dataset, a large collection derived from the PTB Diagnostic ECG Database and the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Dataset. The primary objective of this project is to improve myocardial infarction (MI) early detection. To identify MI in ECG readings, a number of machine learning models—including unique deep neural network architectures—have been meticulously created and put into practice. The study emphasizes how machine learning can distinguish between heartbeats that are normal and those that are impacted by various arrhythmia, which will enhance diagnostics for cardiac health. Three distinct machine learning models have been compared indepth in order to evaluate each model’s efficacy. The main aim of this study is to demonstrate how artificial intelligence can be of great significance in early MI detection. The comprehensive evaluation of model efficacy conducted in this research is expected to have a significant influence on future developments in the field of cardiac health diagnosis.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Database Construction of Vocal Choral Audio Storage on the Basis of Independent Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Music art is an important component of human art, and its forms of expression are mainly achieved through various forms such as vocal, choir, and instrumental music. Vocal choir, and audio are important components, but current research and application mainly focus on digital storage based on recording, and there is a lack of research on feature extraction and database construction for audio storage. Based on independent component analysis, this article took vocal choir audio as the research object to address these issues. Through research on feature extraction, library construction, and database construction, a practical and feasible database construction plan was proposed. By analyzing the experimental results, it can be concluded that the highest signal-to-noise ratio of the feature extraction method based on independent component analysis reached 44.8dB. Therefore, feature extraction and database construction based on independent component analysis play an important role in vocal choir audio libraries.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Effectiveness Assessment Model for University Student Psychological Counseling Data Based on Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Psychological counseling for university students has received much attention in recent years, and how to effectively assess the effectiveness of a large amount of counseling data has become an urgent problem to be solved. This article aims to propose a validity assessment model for university student psychological counseling data based on deep learning (DL), and compare it with traditional decision tree (DT) algorithm to verify its superiority and practicality. Based on the characteristics of the data and the actual needs of assessment, this study will carefully design the network structure and optimize the model through training to ensure that it can accurately capture effective features from the data. Through comparative experiments, the DL algorithm proposed in this article is significantly superior to the DT algorithm in terms of prediction accuracy, operational efficiency, and model stability. The DL algorithm has shown significant advantages in evaluating the effectiveness of psychological counseling data for university students. This algorithm can more accurately assess the effectiveness of counseling data, provide strong support for psychological counseling services for university students, and promote progress and development in this field.

articleTitle: Interior Design System Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: People usually use tools such as hand drawn or computer aided design (CAD) for interior design, but this method cannot effectively simulate real spatial effects, which is difficult to meet customers' needs for spatial effects, and it is also difficult for customers to truly feel the atmosphere and emotions of the space. This article aims to utilize advanced virtual reality (VR) modern technology to achieve precise simulation and in-depth display of interior design, and provide customers with more convenient, efficient, and realistic interior design services. By utilizing VR technology to achieve realistic simulation of spatial effects, customers can experience the effects and atmosphere of the space in a more realistic environment, thereby improving their experience. The experimental results of this article indicate that the average time for hard decoration design using VR systems is 58.5% less than the average time for hard decoration design using CAD systems. The interior design system based on VR optimizes the process and efficiency of interior design, helps designers better complete design tasks, and improves design effectiveness and quality.

articleTitle: Research on the Carbon Asset Management Service Model of Power Grid Company
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The fundamental part of the energy field occupies carbon emissions, and the power in the energy field is the most utilized power. As a hub platform connecting energy production and consumption, the power grid needs to conduct a key optimization research on carbon asset management. Carbon assets are an important prerequisite for implementing the goal of "dual carbon". The two models of the establishment departments and companies in the management of carbon asset management are analyzed in this paper, and then the three carbon asset models of digital service, exclusive service and dual carbon service are studied. The amount of measurement and technical elements in the carbon asset management service model, then analyzing the cleaning and low-carbon and efficient utilization of power grid companies in the carbon asset management service products, finally based on the carbon asset management service model as the case, through the PV energy storage station project, replacing the conventional energy sources of photovoltaic power to reduce carbon emissions, enhance the carbon asset income of corporate carbon assets, reduce operation cost.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Natural Language Processing Based on Deep Learning in Multi-task Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: This article comprehensively discusses the application of natural language processing (NLP) based on deep learning in multi-task learning (MTL). First, the article reviews the basic principles of deep learning, the development history of NLP, the concept of MTL and its application in various fields. Next, the article analyzes in detail the specific application cases of deep learning in NLP, such as language models, sentiment analysis and machine translation, and discusses the successful cases and method summaries of these technologies. In particular, this article focuses on the application of MTL in NLP, and experimentally verifies the advantages of MTL in performance improvement compared to the traditional single-task learning (STL) mode. The experimental part covers research methods and experimental design, data sets and experimental environment, experimental process and result analysis, as well as result discussion and theoretical significance. Finally, the article demonstrates the potential of MTL to improve model generalization capabilities in NLP tasks, and points out the limitations of the research and possible future research directions. The innovation of this study lies in the proposed new deep learning model structure, which is specially optimized for the application of MTL in NLP and its effectiveness is verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Multi-Domain Adaptation and Optimization of English Translation Based on Cross-Language Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Adaptive research in many fields of English translation plays an important role in improving the quality of translation. In this paper, traditional English translation adaptation methods are compared with cross-language transfer learning (CLTL) algorithms, and their performance in terms of translation quality and translation stability is evaluated. It optimizes a multi-domain adaptation approach to English translation based on CLTL. The experimental results show that the method based on CLTL is superior to the traditional method in terms of TER, BLEU value and stability. The results of this study validate the superiority of the approach based on CLTL in the multi-domain adaptation of English translation. The study of this paper provided a useful reference and inspiration for the research and practice of English translation.

articleTitle: Research on LoRa based State Sensing Technology for Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: As an important channel for power transmission, the quality and safety of overhead lines are crucial for the operational status of circuits. If there are problems with its operation, it will directly affect the transmission of power resources and the electricity consumption experience of customers. Therefore, in the daily operation of overhead transmission lines, it is needed to strengthen the operation and maintenance management of overhead transmission lines. However, the distribution range of overhead transmission lines is relatively wide, and the actual operating conditions of the lines are relatively complex. Actual monitoring has great difficulty, and the traditional transmission line operation and inspection mode is no longer suitable for the requirements of lean operation and maintenance. To ensure the normal operation of real-time monitoring, this article proposes an online detection system for overhead line defect status based on LoRa wireless networking and data transmission technology. Design and develop a scalable, low-power, and wireless intelligent sensing node using wireless communication modules and microcontroller units to achieve detection of overhead line defects and transmission of detection data. To fully understand the application of state awareness technology based on LoRa in overhead line monitoring, this study further analyzes the influence of environmental factors such as temperature, humidity and wind on the performance of this technology. Through experiments under different environmental conditions, it is found that these factors will have a certain impact on the propagation distance and stability of LoRa signal. In practical application, it is needed to calibrate and optimize the LoRa sensor according to the specific environmental conditions to ensure its best performance.

articleTitle: Simulation and Interactive Experience of Chinese Landscape Art with Combination of Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the simulation and interactive experience of Chinese garden art landscape, such as user experience, low accuracy of landscape simulation, insufficient landscape content and lack of individuality, this paper used Virtual Reality (VR) technology to study the simulation and interactive experience of Chinese garden art landscape. In this paper, Three-Dimensional (3D) modeling techniques were compared, and 3D Studio Max was selected for virtual garden simulation. It focused on the research of VR modeling technology and virtual system realization, as well as the activity experience brought by VR technology to landscape users, and the paper aim at improving the user’s sense of experience. The error rate of the simulation method of garden art landscape based on VR technology was below 3.43%, and the average error rate of 20 experiments was 2.54%. The introduction of VR technology has brought a new way of viewing, which can be a panoramic rendering of the tour, but also can be a free roam within the model scene.

articleTitle: A LSTM Algorithm for Accounting Financial Investment Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Accounting Financial investment is the specialized field of studying and managing money flows, investment decisions and financial risk to ensure maximum return on assets. In today's society, accounting and financial investment forecasts have serious errors and error rates. In this paper, XGBoost model is constructed by LSTM algorithm to forecast accounting financial investment. Finally, through the experiment, it is concluded that the algorithm greatly reduces the error rate of accounting financial investment forecast, and improves its accuracy rate, and the accuracy rate is as high as 97.8%. In the future, LSTM algorithm and accounting financial investment forecast should be widely used.

articleTitle: Art and Design of Doors and Windows Based on Computer Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The traditional art design of doors and windows usually relies on manual drawing, physical model making and empirical judgment to evaluate the design scheme. However, this method has some limitations, such as high cost, long time, difficult to visually display the effect, so the art design of doors and windows based on computer simulation technology came into being. According to the computer simulation technology, the 3D rapid design of doors and windows can be carried out. Based on the computer simulation platform, the various performances and effects of doors and windows can be simulated, such as visual effects, sound insulation, air tightness, etc., and the simulation results of different design schemes can be quickly generated. The model is parameterized and the 3D fast design scheme of doors and windows is built, which saves time and cost. The experimental results showed that the average design time of wood doors and windows in computer simulation design was 65.3% less than that in traditional manual design. This method can effectively improve the design speed, provide efficient data support for intelligent manufacturing system, has good application prospect and popularization value, and can bring new ideas and methods for the design of doors and windows.

Author Keywords: Art and Design of Doors and Windows

articleTitle: Research on Road Material Combination Optimization and Its Application Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of urbanization, the paving area of squares and roads has greatly increased, and patches of cement and bricks have replaced the original vegetation and soil. The quality inspection of urban road and bridge construction materials is closely related to transportation safety and the safety of people’s lives. For road and bridge engineering, construction materials will have a significant impact on the overall construction quality, so it is necessary to strengthen the effective implementation of material quality inspection work. Due to the shortcomings of traditional material testing methods and the low accuracy of test results, it is necessary to strengthen the scientific application of testing technology. Genetic algorithm (GA) can overcome various difficulties faced by traditional algorithms in solving complex problems, and can better solve practical problems in people’s lives. In order to optimize the vibration and noise reduction performance of road materials and extend the service life of the road surface, this article uses GA for material quality testing to achieve optimization of road material combination. The experimental results show that using GA can improve the efficiency of optimization calculation, and the optimized road material composition has a higher strength ratio, thus achieving more accurate and reasonable road optimization design.

articleTitle: Multi-Focus Image Fusion Algorithm Based on Double Tree Complex Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The image fusion technology based on wavelet transform is one of the development frontier of pixel-level multi-focus image fusion technology. Although the discrete wavelet transform technology is local and multi-resolution, it will lose the translation invariance of Fourier transform, and it can't represent the directional feature of image well. In order to solve these problems, a Multi-focus image fusion algorithm based on dual-tree complex wavelet transform (MIFWT) is proposed in this paper, which not only maintains the excellent time-frequency localization analysis ability of traditional wavelet, but also has excellent directional analysis ability, and can reflect the situation that the image changes in different directions at different resolution, and can better describe the direction of the image. Simulation results prove the proposed algorithm to be effective.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Twin Modeling Technology for Distribution Networks Integrating Multiple Digital Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The sources of digital resources in the distribution network mainly include three aspects: equipment ontology, production operation, and management. The data is described in various forms and stored in various types of systems and data platforms. However, with the continuous development and upgrading of distribution network business, the fusion of diverse data resources to drive decision-making has become a current development trend. Therefore, how to integrate and apply diverse digital resources is the key to the current development of distribution networks. In response to this issue, the article proposes a digital twin modeling technique for distribution networks that integrates multiple digital resources. Firstly, build a cross platform data mapping system based on the production and operation data management rules of the distribution network, and then use data access and integration technology to integrate diverse data resources into a unified data platform. Utilize the unified data model of the power grid to align multiple data resources and map the aligned data resources to the digital twin model. Simultaneously defining data synchronization update interfaces to ensure real-time and accurate data in the digital twin model. Finally, a typical scenario application of the distribution network based on the digital twin model is carried out to verify the effectiveness and practicality of the model.

articleTitle: A K-means Algorithm for Higher Education Quality Assessment System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The higher education quality assessment system is designed to evaluate and improve the standards of tertiary education through a set of criteria that reflect the academic, operational, and societal outcomes of institutions in the context of global educational competitiveness. The higher education quality assessment system has serious errors rate and inefficiency. This article uses the K-means algorithm to establish a high-level educational evaluation system, and finally draws conclusions through experiments. This algorithm greatly reduces the error rate and greatly improves the efficiency of highly educational evaluation systems.

articleTitle: Studies on Intelligent Recognition and Deep Learning-Based English Translation Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: This study focuses on an English translation model based on intelligent recognition and deep learning, aiming to improve translation accuracy and efficiency. Firstly, by introducing intelligent recognition technology, the model is able to understand the semantic information of source language sentences more accurately. Second, a deep learning framework is adopted to achieve integrated learning and reasoning for the entire translation task through end-to-end neural network optimisation. In order to comprehensively evaluate the model performance, we designed experiments to compare it with other models, including Model A, which employs an improved GLR algorithm, and Model B, a grammar-based neural machine translation model. In the experiments, we verified the superior performance of the English translation model based on intelligent recognition and deep learning in terms of part-of-speech recognition and translation time for English phrases. The experimental results show that in terms of speech recognition accuracy, this model achieves 100% accuracy, which is significantly ahead of other models. In terms of translation time, this model takes less than 5 seconds, which is more efficient compared to other models. The contribution of this research is to integrate intelligent recognition and deep learning to propose a powerful English translation model. The model performs well in both the key aspects of speech recognition and translation time, providing a feasible and efficient solution for practical applications. Future research directions could include further optimising the model details, expanding the language pairs and domain coverage to meet a wider range of translation needs.

articleTitle: Wireless Sensor Network Access Control Technology with Joint Optimization of Delay and Power Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Nowadays is the era of interconnected everything, and the entire network system is becoming increasingly large. At this time, the carrying capacity of the network will gradually become a constraint. Therefore, research on access control for large-scale wireless sensor networks (WSNs) is urgent. With the rapid increase in the number of network service terminal sites, the continuous improvement of network service latency requirements and security performance, and the significant increase in network energy consumption, the new generation of Internet of Things (IOT) systems are facing a series of new technological challenges. In WSN, latency and power performance are often a pair of indicators that cannot be achieved simultaneously. How to optimize and balance these two indicators is a challenge in routing and MAC algorithms. We choose sensor nodes with different specifications and performance, and build a practical WSN test platform. On this platform, we measure the delay and power consumption data of the algorithm in the actual transmission process. The experimental results show that compared with the simulation research, the proposed algorithm also shows lower delay and power consumption on real hardware, which verifies the practicability of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Motion Decomposition and Guidance Technology in Dance Teaching Based on Motion Feedback System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Through the construction of real-time feedback system, it can decompose dance movements in a low-cost and efficient way, and solve the problems of high cost of traditional dance teaching and guidance, untimely feedback and personalized. Firstly, this paper collected the dance movement data of students through sensors and cameras for real-time processing and analysis; secondly, based on PoseNet model, students’ actions were identified and decomposed into key action steps. Then, by developing a feedback system, the decomposed action information was fed back to students. At the same time, the paper combined the Alternating Least Squares (ALS) to formulate targeted guidance strategies. The performance of the technique is evaluated by the performance accuracy, student progress rate and learning satisfaction. The results show that the system can improve the accuracy of dance movements by 10% to 20%. This innovative approach has been successful in the field of dance education, providing students with a better learning experience.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Pricing and Replenishment Decision of Vegetable Products Based on Association Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Vegetable merchandise sales play an important role in retailing, so effective pricing and replenishment strategies are critical to improving profits and customer satisfaction. A large amount of historical sales data including sales volume, price, seasonal variations and other relevant factors of vegetable items were first collected. Then, association models, such as association rule mining or collaborative filtering-based approaches, are used to analyse this data to discover the correlations between different commodities and customer purchasing patterns. In addition, association models can be used to predict future demand to optimise replenishment decisions. For example, if certain vegetable items are frequently purchased together, the system can automatically trigger a replenishment operation when the stock of one of the items falls below a certain threshold. Finally, the research could also explore how to take into account the impact of seasonal factors, promotional activities and competition on pricing and replenishment decisions to further improve the accuracy and usefulness of the model. This approach can be applied in real retail environments to provide merchants with smarter decision support.

articleTitle: Research on Interactive Data Visualization Technology Based on Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: This study aims to explore interactive data visualization technology based on augmented reality (AR). By comprehensively analyzing the current development of AR technology and the needs of data visualization, this paper proposes a new interactive data visualization framework. First, the basic principles of augmented reality technology and its application potential in data visualization are introduced. Subsequently, the design principles, implementation methods, and comparisons with traditional data visualization techniques of the framework are described in detail. Through a series of experiments, the effectiveness of this framework in improving data presentation and enhancing user interaction experience was verified. Experimental results show that this technology can significantly improve the understandability and interactivity of data. Finally, the application prospects of this technology in different fields, such as education, business analysis, etc., and its future development directions are discussed. This research provides a new perspective and practical guidance for the application of AR technology in the field of interactive data visualization.

articleTitle: Transformative AI in Skin Care: The Synergy of Transfer Learning and EfficientNetV2 B0
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Accurate skin mole categorization is essential for early skin cancer identification and treatment in dermatological diagnostics. This study uses the sophisticated transfer learning approach using the EfficientNet V2 B0 model, a convolutional neural network renowned for its effectiveness and high accuracy in image classification tasks, to provide a novel method of differentiating benign from malignant skin moles. The work’s primary contribution is optimizing the EfficientNet V2 B0 model for high accuracy in a medical setting by tailoring it to the unique characteristics of dermatological images. By incorporating unique layers and using specific training methodologies, we improved the transfer learning model’s capacity to identify minute characteristics that may indicate skin mole malignancy. After a thorough validation, the model showed an incredible 98.7% classification accuracy, outperforming the industry norms. This high degree of accuracy opens the door for more dependable, non-invasive skin cancer screening techniques as well as highlights the possibilities of using cutting-edge deep learning models in medical diagnostics. The results of this study might lessen the need for invasive biopsy procedures and provide prompt therapy, which would impact early identification and intervention tactics.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Saving and Environmental Protection Optimization Design of Buildings from the Perspective of Environment Friendliness
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: To promote sustainable building design, it’s vital to balance improved thermal conditions with energy conservation. Achieving this balance relies on prudent energy use and maximizing efficiency without causing unnecessary waste. This approach supports human well-being and ecological sustainability. This study, focusing on residential buildings, investigates the optimal design for energy-efficient and environmentally friendly structures. It distinguishes between single-objective and multi-objective optimization approaches, with a particular emphasis on the latter. We introduce an enhanced multi-objective Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) method that refines the mutation operator within the algorithm. Our experiments reveal substantial improvements in the four enhanced PSO algorithms over the standard PSO. This is evident in an approximate 1.35% reduction in the average objective function value and a threefold or more enhancement in convergence rates. These enhancements translate into superior optimization outcomes compared to conventional PSO methods. Additionally, our research prioritizes environmental concerns while achieving a unified control over indoor environments and energy consumption, ensuring the lowest energy usage within eco-friendly parameters. This study is a significant step towards environmentally conscious, energy-efficient building design.

articleTitle: Intelligent Parking Path Planning Based on Ackermann Steering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet industry and the great increase in the popularity of vehicles, the "Internet plus product" has become a new type of business. In large cities with limited parking space or parking lots with crowded vehicles, intelligent parking is a more practical function, which reduces the difficulty for drivers to drive into a narrow space. However, due to the immature technology, the utilization rate has been low. Therefore, in order to improve product utilization and facilitate parking, intelligent parking has become a research hotspot. Through the establishment of mathematical models and the utilization of algorithms, intelligent parking can accurately plan parking paths to prevent losses caused by vehicle scratches. Simultaneously utilizing the function of intelligent parking, it reduces traffic accidents caused by improper operation during the parking process, providing convenience and safe parking guarantee for drivers. This article conducts relevant research on path planning for the intelligent parking problem of autonomous vehicles. Establish a mathematical model based on the Ackermann structural steering, analyze the rate of change limit of curvature relative to the length of the path, and gradually analyze the vertical and parallel parking path modes. Establish a parking planning coordinate system based on the characteristics of vertical and parallel parking conditions. For parallel parking: By establishing a parking model for parallel parking, analyze the path of parallel parking and plan the parking speed, obtain a speed time relationship curve, and then plan the parallel parking path; For vertical parking: Analyze the vertical parking status and establish a model. By using the midpoint of the vehicle's rear axle as a reference point, derive the kinematic model of a four-wheel steering vehicle and calculate the ${\left({{X_r} - {X_o}}\right)^2} + {\left({{Y_r} + Lcot(\delta ) - {Y_o}}\right)^2} = {\left({Lcot(\delta )}\right)^2}$ vertical parking trajectory equation, thereby planning the vertical parking path.

articleTitle: Applicability of Pricing Basis for Green Construction Based on Life Cycle Cost Analysis: Taking Power Transmission and Transformation Project as an Example
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: With the increasingly prominent global environmental issues, the concept of GC (Green Construction) has gradually become a development trend in the construction industry. The pricing basis for GC that integrates life cycle cost analysis is of great significance for evaluating the economic and sustainability of building projects. The traditional engineering pricing model often overlooks the energy consumption, maintenance costs, and environmental impact of buildings throughout their entire life cycle. The research results indicate that the GC pricing basis integrating life cycle cost analysis has good applicability in power transmission and transformation projects, with a resource utilization rate 10.7% higher than traditional pricing models. It can comprehensively evaluate the cost and environmental impact of construction projects and provide scientific basis for decision-makers.

articleTitle: Improvement of Confidence of Learners of Oral English in College English Integrating Speech Emotion Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: In traditional English oral learning, only limited feedback information can be provided, which cannot deeply analyze and diagnose the emotional characteristics of learners’ speech expression, directly affecting students’ confidence. By automatically analyzing learners’ speech data, including intonation, speaking speed, tone, etc., combined with emotion recognition algorithms, learners’ oral expression can be evaluated and fed back, helping them improve their oral ability and enhance their confidence. Three dimension convolutional neural network with residual network (Res3DCNN) was utilized to extract spectral-temporal features of emotional speech from spectrograms. Then, the long-term dependency relationships of students’ speech emotional features were extracted, and emotional features in oral expression were automatically detected and classified, such as confidence, tension, excitement, etc. Through experiments, it has been proven that the use of speech emotion recognition technology has improved the learners’ confidence of oral English in college English. Through this approach, learners can gain a more comprehensive understanding of their emotional state in oral expression, thereby improving and adjusting their oral language.

articleTitle: Insight Analysis of Tourists' Behavior and Preference by Deep Learning in Tourism Destination Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: With the rapid development of tourism, the application of deep learning technology in tourism destination management has gradually attracted widespread attention. The purpose of this study is to explore the potential value of deep learning in the insight analysis of tourists' behavior and preferences, so as to provide better decision support for tourism destination management. By analyzing the massive data left by tourists in social media, mobile applications and online comments, we adopt deep learning methods, including neural network and natural language processing technology, to extract key information about tourists' behaviors and preferences. Research shows that deep learning technology can effectively gain insight into tourists' behavior, including travel preferences, activity selection and time arrangement; It helps to identify tourists' interest points and hot spots, and predict future tourism trends; Deep learning can also provide personalized travel advice and improve tourists' satisfaction and loyalty. This study provides a powerful tool for tourism destination managers, helping them to better understand tourists' needs, plan resources, improve the attraction of destinations, and thus promote the sustainable development of tourism.

articleTitle: Application and Challenge of Convolutional Neural Network in Traditional Village Ecological Landscape Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Against the backdrop of rapid technological advancements, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), as a core technology in the field of deep learning, have gradually become an important tool in the ecological landscape design of traditional villages. This paper focuses on the ResNet50 model, delving into the effectiveness and challenges of CNN’s application in traditional village design. The article provides a detailed overview of CNN’s multi-level feature extraction capabilities and its exceptional performance in element recognition within traditional villages. Through specific case studies, this research demonstrates the advantages of CNN in capturing and understanding the diverse scales and layers of traditional village elements. These insights offer designers richer and more efficient tools, fostering a deep integration of traditional culture with modern technology. The article also thoroughly examines the challenges encountered in the application of CNN, such as data diversity, scene complexity, ethical privacy concerns, and real-time performance. Future research will focus on creating more diverse data sets, enhancing the model’s ability to handle complex scenarios, and ensuring data privacy and ethical compliance throughout technological development. The paper concludes that, through these balanced measures, CNN will continually explore new realms in the ecological landscape design of traditional villages, promoting an organic blend of tradition and modernity for more sustainable development.

articleTitle: Analysis and Enhancement Strategies of Private Undergraduate Students' Learning Effect of Principle of Singlechip Based on Online and Offline Mixed-mode Teaching: K-Fold Cross-Validation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The principle of single chip microcomputer is a professional basic course with "program design" as the main line, and it is also a very practical course, involving a lot of practical engineering applications. For private undergraduate colleges, there are some difficulties and challenges in the teaching process. In this paper, k-fold cross-verification method is adopted to analyze and improve the learning effect of singlechip microcomputer based on the mixed mode of online and offline teaching. This is a student-centered, teacher-guided, student-independent learning as the purpose, fully mobilize students’ subjective initiative and enthusiasm, improve learning efficiency and effect of teaching methods. The experimental results show that this method can improve the students’ motivation score to 85 points, which was 12 points higher than the previous maximum score of 73 points. At the same time, innovation ability, practical ability and sense of achievement have also improved. It can be seen that the method adopted in the article has a good effect in improving the learning effect.

articleTitle: A K-means Algorithm for Drone-assisted Legal Privacy Protection Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Legal regulation of drones usually aims to balance the improvement of innovation and efficiency with the protection of personal privacy rights, and avoid infringement of personal privacy when conducting aerial surveillance. In today's society, drone-assisted legal supervision and privacy protection monitoring have high operational difficulty and error rates. The K-means algorithm in machine learning is an efficient monitoring technology. Compared with traditional monitoring algorithms, the K-means algorithm has higher ease of operation and accuracy. This article uses the K-means algorithm to establish a monitoring system, which greatly improves the accuracy of monitoring and simplifies the difficulty of operation. Finally, through experiments, it was concluded that the K-means algorithm is simpler to operate and has higher accuracy, which can reach 97.63%.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Analysis of the approaches of Integrating Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: This study has investigated the current state of AI research and identified trends, methods, and sources in its integration in the higher education (HE). A thorough search of academic literature using Scopus database, collecting relevant articles. Techniques like co-citation analysis, co-occurrence analysis, and keyword co-occurrence analysis were employed for analysis. The results reflect a growing interest in AI in the HE. Intelligent tutoring systems, adaptive learning environments, and automated assessment tools emerged as prominent research themes. Influential sources and collaborations among researchers were also identified, shedding light on key contributors. Furthermore, the study observed the emergence of new AI technologies, including adaptive learning and personalized learning, in higher education. It provides a comprehensive overview of existing literature, offering valuable insights for researchers, practitioners, and policymakers aiming to enhance the learning processes in HE institutions using AI. The findings inform future research directions and highlight potential areas for further exploration and development.

articleTitle: Adaptive Payload Defense: A Cutting-Edge k-NN Framework for Web Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Web applications are essential components of today’s digital ecosystems, allowing for smooth interactions and data transmission. The persistent concerns of SQL injection (SQLi) and Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks, on the other hand, continue to pose substantial problems to the security of these systems. Traditional security methods are frequently ineffective in mitigating these risks, demanding a more dynamic and adaptive approach. This research investigates a novel way to bolster web application security by employing machine learning, specifically the k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithm, for attack payload generation. The implementation of the k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) technique for creating malicious payloads in the context of SQL injection (SQLi) and Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks on web applications is investigated in this work. The work presents a prototype system that incorporates KNN into the payload generation process, proving its effectiveness in constructing context-aware payloads that elude standard detection systems. The results of the prototype system demonstrate the method’s usefulness in circumventing typical security protections. This study provides valuable insights into improving web application security by emphasizing the role of machine learning in proactively tackling growing cybersecurity threats.

articleTitle: Improvement of Simulation Algorithm for Painting Process of Traditional Chinese Painting Works by Integrating Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: It is often difficult for traditional algorithms to capture the real painting process of Chinese painting, unable to show the artist’s unique creative style and skills, resulting in the lack of artistic sense of the generated works. Through deep learning technology and transfer learning method, this paper improved the simulation algorithm of the painting process of Chinese painting art works, better simulated the artist’s creative process and style, and generated more artistic works. This paper collected a large number of painting images of Chinese painting art works, preprocessed the images, built ResNet model, and adjusted the output layer of ResNet model. It output the style of Chinese painting through a pixel matrix of appropriate size, and integrated the fine-tuned ResNet model with transfer learning. In this paper, the ResNet fusion transfer learning model was fully trained. The results of the test set showed that the accuracy rate of ResNet fusion transfer learning model for painting style simulation of Chinese painting works was 95.6%. Therefore, the application of ResNet fusion transfer learning model can effectively improve the accuracy of the painting process simulation of Chinese painting works.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Art Therapy Effect Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Promote industrial agglomeration and promote the transformation and upgrading of traditional enterprises. It is not enough to rely solely on technology integration. We should rely on the transformation of Internet marketing model, management model and even business model, arm our minds with Internet thinking, and transform industrial management and supply value chain. In this paper, a DL model combining convolutional neural network (CNN) and Long short-term memory(LSTM) is constructed. Through end-to-end learning of artistic creation data, the model can capture the complex relationship between multimodal information. In the training process, careful data preprocessing and model optimization are adopted to improve the performance of the model. In extensive experiments, our model has achieved satisfactory results on the test set. The analysis of confusion matrix and classification report shows that the model has achieved good prediction performance in many categories of art treatment effect, which provides effective identification and support for individual treatment needs. This study proves the great potential of DL in the evaluation of art therapy effect. Our model not only provides therapists with more comprehensive patient information, but also provides strong support for the formulation of personalized treatment plans.

articleTitle: Prediction and Incentive of Number of Participants in Rural Cultural Square Activities by Integrating Pattern Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The traditional method relies on historical data and simple statistical model to predict the number of participants in rural cultural square activities, which cannot fully take into account various complex factors and changes, and it is difficult to accurately predict and motivate the number of participants in rural cultural square activities. By integrating pattern recognition algorithms, a feasible method is provided to help organizers better plan and manage rural cultural square activities, in order to achieve the goals of community development and social interaction. This paper collected a large number of rural cultural square activity data and preprocessed the collected data. It combined the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model and the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model to build the CNN-LSTM model. According to the number of participants predicted by CNN-LSTM model and the characteristics of activities, the incentive strategy is formulated. The experimental results showed that the accuracy of CNN-LSTM model in predicting the number of participants in rural cultural square activities was as high as 95.8%. The integration of CNN model and LSTM model can effectively improve the prediction of the number of participants in rural cultural square activities and improve the incentive effect.

articleTitle: Volatility Prediction Algorithm in Enterprise Financial Risk Management Based on Markov Chain Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Enterprise financial risk management needs to predict the future volatility quickly and accurately in order to formulate corresponding risk management strategies. This paper uses the Markov chain algorithm to predict the volatility of corporate financial risk management, providing an estimate of future risk fluctuations and helping firms to make faster and more accurate decisions and planning. Firstly, the Markov chain algorithm is studied and the prediction formula is proposed. Secondly, the prediction model based on Markov chain algorithm is constructed for the volatility of enterprise financial risk management. Finally, the prediction model is compared with the common prediction model. The prediction efficiency and average value of the enterprise financial risk volatility prediction model based on Markov chain algorithm were the highest, above 85%. The average prediction accuracy was also the highest at more than 95%. The prediction effect of financial risk fluctuation based on Markov chain algorithm is remarkable, which improves the prediction efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Construction and Optimization Strategy of University Teaching Management Platform Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, big data technology has become an important tool in various industries. In the context of big data, the informatization construction of teaching management in universities has rich connotations. Data mining, mobile learning, and other popular models of teaching management systems have become popular. The application of big data in universities can achieve the digitization and intelligence of teaching management. In view of this, this article delves into the application of big data technology in university teaching management, including data collection, storage, analysis, and visualization. Then, the problems existing in the current university teaching management platform were analyzed, such as low data quality, insufficient data analysis capabilities, and poor user experience. On this basis, a university teaching management platform based on distributed big data technology was designed, and optimization strategies such as implementing data privacy protection, strengthening data management, breaking through traditional constraints, and establishing scientific and unified standards for educational data were proposed. It is expected to provide reference for the construction of university teaching management platforms.

articleTitle: A Wideband Half Mode SIW-Based RDRA MIMO Antenna for Next-Generation 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel design featuring Half Mode SIW fed four element RDRA MIMO. The proposed MIMO RDRA configuration offers a combination of polarization and spatial diversity to effectively counteract signal interference from multiple paths. The suggested MIMO DRA exhibits a simulated impedance bandwidth of 17.95% (36.3 GHz to 43.46 GHz) while maintaining inter-port isolation more than 21 dB over the entire frequency range. The proposed design has a peak gain of 5.37 to 10.90 dBi over the desired frequency band. Extensive analysis reveals a channel capacity loss (CCL) below 0.6 bits/sec/Hz and an envelope correlation coefficient (ECC) lower than 0.0025 across the frequency range of operation. The findings demonstrate the potential of this antenna design for future 5G systems.

articleTitle: Empowering India's Industry 4.0 Excellence: Pioneering Training Methodologies for WorldSkills Competition Preparation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: With India’s opening out into the global market, there is now greater demand for producing products at competitive costs and lesser lead times. This has introduced a greater and greater degree of automation into our manufacturing industries as a means of cost reduction. In this context, acquiring expertise in Industry 4.0 is indispensable, since the transition from Industry 3.0 to 4.0 is now taking place at a faster rate. Developing skills in Industry 4.0 allows one to leverage automation, data analysis, and connectivity, ensuring competitiveness in a swiftly changing industrial environment. This paper delves into our approach to preparing the students for the WorldSkills Competition, a global platform showcasing industry-aligned skill excellence. We illustrate our meticulous strategy in motivating and training students, facilitating their journey from the initial stages to the international arena. Our methodology encompasses rigorous training, rigorous selection processes, and participation in regional and national skill competitions, culminating in the prestigious representation of India at WorldSkills 2022 Special Edition in Stuttgart, Germany. Team India excelled in the industry 4.0 Skill category, securing 648 out of 700 points. Their success was attributed to a well-structured training approach, proving vital for their performance on the global stage. This paper explores the training methods behind their triumph and offers insights for future competitors and educators.

articleTitle: Practice and Exploration of Intelligent Perception Technology in Improving Urban Water System Landscape
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: There are many factors worth considering in the design of water system landscapes, and water system landscapes are often an important component of urban landscapes. Therefore, this article aimed to improve the current urban water system landscape design through intelligent perception technology, making it more adaptable to the environment and more popular among tourists. Therefore, in the end of this article, a comparative test was conducted between intelligent perception technology and digital devices, and the former was set as the experimental group and the latter as the control group to observe which technology can make a similar landscape more popular. The result was that in the same month in different years, the average number of tourists in the experimental group was 2103, while the average number of tourists in the control group was only 1715. This study found that intelligent perception technology can effectively improve the design of urban water system landscapes.

articleTitle: Implementation and Assessment of China's Green Finance Policies on Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: China's green finance policies have shown initial effectiveness in promoting sustainable development. The framework for a green finance system has been established, and there has been rapid growth in green loans and green bond issuance, which has positively impacted the development of green industries. However, challenges related to regulatory oversight and the efficiency of fund utilization persist, with some projects raising questions about their environmental benefits, leading to instances of "greenwashing." Therefore, there is a need to construct a scientific policy effectiveness assessment system, utilizing dynamic evaluations based on environmental and economic indicators such as carbon reduction and employment. Strengthening end-to-end supervision and establishing third-party evaluation mechanisms are essential to enhance policy implementation and fund utilization efficiency. Only by ensuring precise allocation of funds to genuinely green projects and continuously refining the policy system can these measures have a lasting impact on promoting the green and low-carbon transformation.

articleTitle: Bitcoin Volatility Analysis with the use of Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Bitcoin is a digital currency created by a large number of calculations based on a specific algorithm. With the time development, more investors came into the market and the price of the bitcoin had been changing all the time. But bitcoin investors want to be able to predict price fluctuations because they don't want to lose their profits. This paper uses machine learning and artificial intelligence to make some reasonable predictions about Bitcoin price fluctuations.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategies for Analyzing Piano Learners’ Practice Time and Frequency Using Data Mining Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: How to choose the best number of exercises reasonably is the key to improve the learning efficiency in piano learning, but how to effectively optimize the practice of students is still an urgent problem to be solved. Therefore, this paper studied students’ learning motivation from the aspects of learners’ age, learning experience, practice time, practice plan and so on, and analyzed students’ learning motivation. On this basis, the collected experimental data is divided into two groups, and the Data Mining (DM) algorithm is used to optimize the experimental data individually, while the control group remains unchanged. The results show that the individualized practice scheme produced by the DM algorithm can obviously improve the practice effect of students. Therefore, the research method in this paper provides a feasible solution for piano learners to optimize the practice time and frequency, which is of great significance for improving the piano learning effect.

articleTitle: RNN Predication for COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The global impact of the COVID-19 pandemic necessitates a comprehensive understanding of outbreak data for effective response. This study focuses on in-depth analysis using time series prediction models, specifically Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit Network (GRUNet), applied to COVID-19 data from Hopkinson University. The study acknowledges the multifactorial nature of COVID-19 complexities, simplifying the problem to time-series data. The methods section details the mechanisms of RNNs, LSTM, and GRU, emphasizing their capabilities in capturing temporal dependencies and addressing long-term dependencies. The experimental phase visualizes COVID-19 data trends in the United States, highlighting the surge potentially linked to the Omicron variant. Two experimental models, LSTM and GRUNet, are compared, with training configurations and visualizations presented for each. However, the analysis of prediction results reveals limitations in accurately forecasting future COVID-19 trends, attributed to the dynamic nature of the virus and evolving strains, leading to increased transmissibility. The lack of effective control measures further hinders predictive capabilities.

articleTitle: Research on the Design Scheme Construction of Industrial Big Data Platform Based on Enterprise Portrait
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The complexity and numerous influencing factors of the industrial chain make precise monitoring, optimized control, and scientific management extremely difficult. However, utilizing big data technology to achieve full factor correlation analysis of industries is an effective way to support the modernization development of industries in the future. On the basis of analyzing the current situation of industrial big data applications, this article elaborates on the functions and objectives of the industrial big data platform, and constructs the overall architecture of the platform from four aspects: technical architecture, data architecture, application architecture, and physical architecture. At the same time, this article also analyzes the two key technologies involved in the platform, and combines machine learning related algorithms to profile enterprises, multi-dimensional mining of enterprise information for data display services. By building this platform, precise industrial management based on big data can be achieved, more scientific and objective industrial guidance policies can be formulated, supporting industrial management decisions, and providing valuable references for industrial informatization and intelligent transformation and upgrading.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study Between Economic Models and Machine Learning Models for Bitcoin Return Volatility Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The significant difference between Bitcoin and other assets is that it is usually highly volatile. Therefore, it is very important for investors to predict the future trend of Bitcoin. Quantifying and modeling Bitcoin's return volatility poses new challenges. This paper selects traditional econometric models Random Walk, GARCH, and machine learning models Fully Connected with NN and LSTM to predict Bitcoin return volatility from January 1, 2018 to January 1, 2023. The purpose of this study is to compare the predictive performance of these models. The accuracy of the prediction was assessed using Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and Root Mean Square Percentage Error (RMSPE). Our results show that the LSTM model has the best performance with minimal RMSE and RMSPE.

articleTitle: Research on Laboratory Safety Management System Based on HTML/CSS+PHP+MySQL Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The presence of a variety of potentially hazardous substances in the laboratory and the large number of laboratory staff on a rotating basis make laboratory staff inevitably a "high-risk group", so much so that the laboratory is known as an "accident pressure cooker" in contemporary times. The current laboratory safety management process in China suffers from a range of problems, including unsafe human behaviour, unsafe physical conditions and a lack of safety management systems. To address this range of issues, the use of the Internet of Things and computer applications for laboratory safety management has become a popular trend. Therefore, this paper researches and designs a laboratory safety management system based on HTML/CSS+PHP+MySQL internet technology to scientifically and effectively inform the laboratory safety management and to prevent as much as possible the safety problems that may occur during the whole process of laboratory experimental operation, so as to better realize the laboratory safety management information, standardization and systematic management. In addition, the system provides real-time updates to laboratory safety management reports, which helps to improve the quality of laboratory safety management and reduce all safety risks.

articleTitle: Optimization of Differential Evolution Algorithm Considering Soil Properties in the Remediation of Heavy Metal Pollution in Mining Soil
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Differential evolution algorithm is an optimization method that obtains the global optimal solution through random search without a clear goal. The article first took the remediation of heavy metal pollution in mining soil as an example to construct a mathematical model for minimizing the cost of soil heavy metal pollution remediation. Then, combined with differential evolution algorithm, the optimization was carried out by combining soil attributes with differential evolution algorithm, and compared with traditional genetic algorithm and particle swarm optimization algorithm. The experimental results showed that the differential evolution algorithm can better handle complex function optimization problems, resulting in a removal rate of up to 95%, a migration rate of up to 89%, and an ecological risk index of down to 3. Using differential evolution algorithm under fixed cost constraints for different soil properties can obtain optimal remediation solutions. Compared to traditional genetic algorithms and particle swarm optimization algorithms, differential evolution algorithms have better capabilities.

articleTitle: Application of Association Rule Analysis in Vocational Education Student Career Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Vocational education should not only pay attention to the cultivation of students' vocational skills, but also pay attention to students' career planning and development. Association rule analysis is a data mining technology, which is used to discover the correlation between data. This article studies the career development prediction model based on association rule analysis, aiming at improving the accuracy and effect of vocational education students' career path planning. By comparing the prediction effect of career development prediction model based on decision tree (DT) algorithm and this algorithm, this algorithm shows better performance in prediction accuracy and effect. Based on the analysis of association rules, this algorithm can deeply explore the correlation between students' individual characteristics and career development, and thus predict students' career path planning more accurately. Compared with the career development prediction model based on DT algorithm, the predicted value of this algorithm is closer to the actual value, and the analysis result of association rules is more intuitive and easy to understand, which is convenient for educators and students to understand the basis and significance of career path planning.

articleTitle: Alarm Root Cause Analysis Based on Knowledge Graph and Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: With the increasing scale and complexity of cloud platforms, effectively handling a large volume of alarm information and accurately pinpointing root causes has become challenging. In this paper, a novel approach based on knowledge graph and Bayesian network is proposed to address the problem of alarm root cause analysis in cloud platforms, called KBroot. This approach constructs an alarm knowledge graph containing domain knowledge, which fully expresses information such as alarm events, maintenance measures, causal correlations, etc. Besides, inference of root cause alarms is performed by using the Bayesian network to calculate the posterior probability of each alarm node being the root cause. Furthermore, by querying the knowledge graph, KBroot obtains fault maintenance measures to provide reference for engineers to fix faults. KBroot offers a comprehensive and enriched representation of domain knowledge while utilizing the probabilistic inference capability of Bayesian networks for precise root cause inference. It provides powerful guidance for troubleshooting cloud platform faults. Experimental results demonstrate that KBroot outperforms other relevant methods in root cause analysis, achieving an accuracy rate of over 90%.

articleTitle: Research on Analytical Modelling of World Population Projections Based on Time Series
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: World population projections have always been important social and economic issues with far-reaching implications for policy formulation and resource allocation. This study aims to develop a world population projection model based on time series analysis to estimate future population trends and changes more accurately. The study uses global population data accumulated over the years and employs time series analysis, including seasonal decomposition, trend analysis and cyclical analysis. First, data cleaning and smoothing were performed on the historical population data to eliminate noise and outliers. Then, using time series analysis techniques, we identified potential trends and cyclical patterns. We also combined machine learning methods, such as ARIMA (Autoregressive Integral Moving Average) models and neural networks, to improve the accuracy of the models. After training and validating the model, we successfully developed a model that accurately predicts future world population changes. By fitting the historical data, we are able to predict the trend of national and global population in the coming decades. This time series-based world population projection model has the potential for a wide range of applications and can help governments, international organisations and policy makers to better plan resource allocation, social security and public policies. In addition, it contributes to an in-depth understanding of global population dynamics and provides strong support for addressing future demographic challenges. Future research efforts will further refine the model to take into account more complex factors, such as sociocultural and political changes, in order to improve the accuracy and usability of the projections.

articleTitle: Design of Electronic Health Record-Based Community Information Medical Service Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Community medical care is an important part of basic medical care. Aiming at the problems of low utilization of residents’ health information, incomplete functions and inefficient service quality in China’s community medical care, this paper proposes a community medical service management system based on Internet technology. The system is based on the establishment of electronic version of residents’ health records, and uses Internet technology to realize the functions of community epidemic monitoring, residents’ health situation analysis, drug delivery and two-way referral. It not only solves the problem of slow data collection progress, but also effectively improves the quality of patient consultation and service efficiency. In addition, the system focuses on the number of residents according to the electronic version of the health record statistics, pushing the relevant health information and strengthening the exchange of information between doctors and patients. This paper provides a new direction for the transformation and improvement of community medical services by studying the health record-based community medical service system.

articleTitle: Game Design and Learning Effectiveness Evaluation of English Teaching Based on Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: English teaching games are an important component of daily English curriculum teaching. Traditional English teaching games lack personalized experiences and are difficult to measure students’ learning outcomes. In order to enhance the applicability of teaching games among different students and improve their English learning experience and effectiveness, this article combined reinforcement learning algorithms to conduct effective research on English teaching game design and learning effectiveness evaluation. This article first explained the design ideas of English teaching games based on the analysis of English learning difficulties and teaching needs. Then, reinforcement learning algorithms were applied to optimize game design, and finally, learning effectiveness evaluation was achieved based on student game behavior data. To verify the effectiveness of teaching game design, this article focused on sixth grade students in a certain primary school, integrated teaching games into English course teaching, and conducted teaching practice and evaluation on them. The results showed that compared to students who learned in the classroom under traditional English teaching games, students who applied English teaching games based on reinforcement learning algorithms improved their average scores at various levels of listening, speaking, reading, and writing by 4.92 points, 5.55 points, 7.34 points, and 6.60 points, respectively. The conclusion indicated that the design of English teaching games based on reinforcement learning algorithms could effectively improve students’ English learning effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Quantitative Evaluation Technology for Intelligent Cabin
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: In recent years, the development of intelligent cabins has been rapid, but testing and evaluation usually involves detecting a single component, lacking a quantitative evaluation method for the overall performance of intelligent cabins. To address this issue, firstly, study the visual interaction elements inside the cabin and summarize the visual interaction testing methods; Then, research auditory interaction testing methods and establish a noise library to achieve reproducible experiments on common external environments; Finally, establish a multi-dimensional comprehensive evaluation method for the intelligent cabin to achieve a comprehensive evaluation of the overall performance of the intelligent cabin.

articleTitle: Design of an Early Learning Car for Garbage Sorting Based on Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: China has comprehensively launched the work of living rubbish classification in cities at the prefecture level and above across the country since 2019, and rubbish classification has begun to be integrated into the daily life of all people. However, due to the lack of awareness of rubbish classification for a long time, it has become a habit for adult groups not to classify rubbish, so the education of rubbish classification for young children is particularly important. In this thesis, an intelligent trolley control system is designed in the context of the implementation of the waste classification policy, aiming to improve the efficiency and accuracy of waste classification in the future by means of waste classification education for young children. The system is based on STM32, K210 and LD3320 control. Firstly, a lightened yolov2 target detection model is used to detect the gesture card teaching aids, and then Kalman filtering is applied to the detection results to achieve the tracking of the detected target on the image and to improve the stability of target detection. Then, PID control algorithm is used to achieve motion control of the trolley so that it can advance to the vicinity of the gesture sign as expected. Finally, the LD3320 recognises the voice of the toddler and opens the corresponding category of bins to achieve trash classification. The experimental results show that the intelligent cart system has good accuracy and stability in target detection and dynamic tracking, and high accuracy in speech recognition, which demonstrates good application prospects in young children's rubbish classification education, and promises to effectively improve the efficiency of rubbish classification and young children's participation, which is of positive significance for the promotion of the implementation of rubbish classification policy.

articleTitle: Research on Communication Optimisation Method for Edge Computing Devices in Ports Based on Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Communication network construction of the port has been developing rapidly in recent years, the volume of communication services is getting bigger and bigger, the distribution of communication pipelines and lines is getting more and more complex, the data of different types of communication equipment is increasing, and the demand for terminal access of communication equipment is increasing, which makes us consider the diversity of terminal services, the difference in transmission quality of heterogeneous network channels and the overlapping coverage, etc., and we need to provide the terminals with self-adaptive network access options. It is necessary to provide the terminal with an adaptive network access selection mechanism to ensure that the terminal is always connected to the most suitable network for service transmission and processing. In this paper, we propose a Federated Learning (FL) communication device optimisation approach based on edge computing through in-depth study of resource communication management in ports. Our proposed method has better performance in simulation experiments compared to other schemes.

articleTitle: FCOS Algorithm-based Object Education for Young Children
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Early childhood is a golden period for the development of a person’s learning ability, and educating children about objects in early childhood can cultivate their ability to recognize common things and objects in life. Early childhood object education can promote children’s ability to recognize and understand things. At present, there are common problems in kindergartens such as "difficulty in identifying objects" and "uninteresting in identifying objects". In this context, the article adopted a preschool object recognition education scheme based on FCOS (Fully Convolutional One-Stage Object Detection) algorithm, and achieved good results in practical teaching.
