The experimental results showed that the accuracy of the FCOS algorithm based method for early childhood object recognition education reached up to 95.1%. From this, it can be concluded that applying FCOS to early childhood object education enables young children to accurately recognize things around them in real life, improves their ability to recognize common things in life, and is beneficial for cultivating their observation and creativity, which has a positive effect on their growth.

articleTitle: Distributed Fault Diagnosis System Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: This research focuses on the development of a machine learning-based distributed fault diagnosis system that aims to improve the accuracy and real-time detection of faults in large-scale distributed systems. By deeply analysing key information such as log data, performance metrics, and network traffic of distributed systems, we design adaptable machine learning algorithms to handle distributed environments of complexity and large scale. In our research, we pay special attention to real-time fault diagnosis to detect and diagnose faults in a timely manner by monitoring and analysing the data flow of distributed systems in real time, thus minimising the potential impact on the system. The proposed machine learning algorithms are not only able to handle large-scale datasets efficiently, but also have the flexibility to adapt to different system architectures and network topologies, while exhibiting good scalability and robustness. In addition, we attempt to introduce an augmented learning approach to enable the fault diagnosis system to actively learn and optimise in order to maintain an efficient fault diagnosis capability in a dynamic and distributed environment. This innovative approach is expected to further improve the system's adaptability to emerging fault modes, thereby enhancing the system's intelligence and self-optimisation capabilities. Overall, this study introduces advanced techniques in machine learning for fault diagnosis in the field of distributed systems and lays the foundation for a more accurate, real-time and intelligent fault diagnosis system.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Diabetes Management in Last Two Decades: A Bibliometric Analysis on Web of Science
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Objectives: To conduct a bibliometric analysis to analyze the landscape of artificial intelligence(AI) in diabetes management in the past two decades.Methods: The literatures on AI in diabetes management during 2003 to 2021 were respectively retrieved from Web of Science database. CiteSpace software was applied to perform analysis of frequency distribution and co-occurrence of sub-keyword terms, frequency distribution analysis of reference citations, and analysis of burst detection methods for keyword terms and cited references, in order to create a knowledge map to reveal diabetes management hotspots and cutting-edge directions.(p/)(p)Results: A total of 1,242 articles on diabetes AI managements were retrieved. The results showed that the number of papers increased year by year, and the number of papers published was the largest in 2019-2021, suggesting that in the field of diabetes management, digital technology was widely adopted in the daily management of diabetes and was conducive in early screening for diabetes complications. In the field of AI in diabetes, various machine learning models including latest deep learning have been proposed and investigated. In the literatures on diabetes digital interventions, the keywords with higher frequency were management, intervention, diabetes, care and blood sugar control. Comparatively, the keywords with the highest frequency in diabetes AI are machine learning, management, diabetes, systems and classification.Conclusions: Publication outputs of the application of AI in DM management have been rising over last two decades. Some hotspots such as mobile medicine, telemedicine, deep learning, and digital therepeutics are of great significance for future research.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach to Financial Text Similarity Using FinBERT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: In the field of finance, text similarity analysis plays a pivotal role in financial decision-making, market forecasting, and risk management. However, due to the specificity of financial texts, which often involve domain-specific terms and complex syntactic structures, conventional text encoding methods have shown limited effectiveness in this domain. This study adopts FinBERT, a model pre-trained on financial corpora, as the basis for text encoding to better capture the semantic information of financial texts. To further enhance feature representation, we combine Self Attention and Convolutional Neural Networks for capturing local text features. By leveraging the strengths of both CNN and self-attention mechanisms, the model achieves a more comprehensive understanding of text similarity. Additionally, this paper introduces a novel heuristic fusion function to integrate information. The heuristic fusion function employs a gating mechanism to control the fusion ratio, mitigating the introduction of noise during fusion. Experimental results on the Ant Financial ATEC dataset in this paper demonstrate that our approach achieves optimal performance, underscoring the effectiveness of our approach in financial text similarity tasks.

articleTitle: Computer-Assisted Spanish and Chinese Interpretation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Spanish and Chinese have a large number of speakers and a wide range of applications, and are important components of the world language system. The current Spanish and Chinese interpretation work mainly relies on a single manual interpretation, which has problems such as strong subjectivity and low efficiency. In order to enhance the objectivity of interpretation work and improve interpretation efficiency, this article conducted in-depth research on the application of computer-assisted Spanish and Chinese interpretation. This article first analyzed the differences and interpretation needs between Spanish and Chinese, and then analyzed the process of establishing a memory bank based on computer-assisted technology. Finally, example sentences were searched and matched in the memory bank, providing assistance and reference for Spanish and Chinese interpretation work. To verify the effectiveness of computer-assisted Spanish and Chinese interpretation application, this article conducted interpretation practice analysis from two aspects: interpretation efficiency and interpretation quality. The results showed that in terms of interpretation efficiency, compared to traditional single manual interpretation, the average duration of computer-assisted interpretation decreased by 0.4 hours. The conclusion indicates that computer-assisted technology can effectively improve the efficiency of Spanish and Chinese interpretation work and provide a new perspective for Spanish and Chinese interpretation work.

articleTitle: Microbial Taxonomy: An Artful Exploration of Microbes with Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Microorganisms, which include a wide range of living forms such as fungi and algae, are essential to human health, biotechnological uses, and ecological equilibrium. Accurate taxonomic categorization of these minuscule organisms is crucial in comprehending their ecological importance and capitalizing on their possibilities in several scientific fields. Our research explores the nexus between microbiology and AI, thoroughly examining our novel method for classifying microorganisms. Our approach is the precise training of sophisticated neural networks on large data sets selected to capture the complex genetic and morphological characteristics unique to every microbe. This work highlights the potential revolutionary effect of deep learning in microbiology and demonstrates the high classification accuracy reached. Our research produced an astounding accuracy of 99%, highlighting the resilience of our method in distinguishing the complex morphological and genetic subtleties unique to every bacterium. Our method’s resilience provides possibilities for automated taxonomic categorization, which may have a wide range of applications, from biotechnological advancements to medical diagnostics and environmental monitoring.

articleTitle: Coverage Enhancement Technology of Wireless Sensor Networks for Power Transmission Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: In this article, firstly, the demand of WSN (Wireless Sensor Network) for power transmission scenarios is analyzed, then the principle and classification of coverage enhancement technology are introduced, and finally the selection and design of coverage enhancement technology for power transmission scenarios are discussed in detail. Aiming at the demand of power transmission scene, this article adopts high-power and anti-interference wireless communication module to improve the transmission distance and anti-interference ability of the sensor. At the same time, a routing algorithm based on multi-hop communication is designed, and intermediate nodes are used for data forwarding to expand the coverage of the network. The node deployment optimization strategy is implemented, and the sensor deployment position is reasonably selected according to the layout and environmental characteristics of power transmission facilities to maximize the network coverage. Finally, the simulation experiment is carried out, and the results show that the network coverage has been significantly improved after adopting the node deployment optimization strategy. At the same time, this method not only improves the communication quality, but also increases the data transmission rate. This shows the effectiveness of this method in optimizing network performance. The research and application of this technology will help to improve the performance of WSN in power transmission scenarios and meet its real-time monitoring requirements for equipment status and environmental parameters.

articleTitle: Analysis of Innovation Path and Competitiveness in the Development of China's New Energy Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The new energy industry is an important component of China's economic transformation. This article systematically explores the current status and existing problems in the development of China's new energy industry, and elaborates on the paths and strategies to promote high-quality development of this industry. The research indicates that to enhance the competitiveness of the new energy industry, it is crucial to uphold a dual-driven approach of technological innovation and business model innovation. This approach aims to overcome limitations related to the reliance on imported core technology equipment and enhance indigenous innovation capabilities. Simultaneously, deepening the reform of the electricity system, establishing fair and efficient market mechanisms and environments, and creating the necessary talent and technology support systems for industry development are essential to achieve synergies and optimize the industry chain. Finally, national-level planning and policy support play a significant role in promoting the transition of old and new energy sources and maintaining long-term competitiveness in the industry.

articleTitle: Examining the Fuzzy Control of The Dynamic Coupling Compensating Cold Storage Refrigeration System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The aim of this study is to explore and evaluate the effect of dynamic coupling compensation on fuzzy control in cold storage refrigeration systems. By analysing the complexity of the cold storage refrigeration system and the coupling relationship between the components in it, a fuzzy control strategy integrating dynamic coupling compensation is proposed. The control strategy aims to regulate the dynamic characteristics of the refrigeration system through coupling compensation to improve the stability and control performance of the system. In the study, firstly, the coupling relationship of each component in the cold storage refrigeration system is described, and the theoretical basis of dynamic coupling compensation control is elaborated. Secondly, a controller model with dynamic coupling compensation is established based on fuzzy control theory. The model combines the advantages of fuzzy logic and neural network control to adapt to the characteristics of the system's dynamic changes and complex coupling relationships. Further, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy in the cold storage refrigeration system is verified through experimental analyses. The response curves of storage room temperature and superheat under different control strategies were observed and analysed to assess the performance of the controller and the stability of the system. The results show that the fuzzy control strategy with dynamic coupling compensation can significantly improve the stability of the cold storage refrigeration system and effectively reduce the overshoot and fluctuation of the system. However, a certain level of control challenges still emerged in some cases, especially in the regulation of the superheat. These results provide insights into the effectiveness and limitations of the control strategy and provide an important reference for future control system improvement and optimisation.

articleTitle: A LSTM Algorithm for Personalized Recommendation for Biotechnology Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The personalized recommendation of biotechnology teaching aims to customize the personalized teaching content and learning path by analyzing the learning habits and progress of students, so as to improve the teaching effect and learning efficiency. In today's society, the personalized recommendation of biotechnology teaching has the problems of cumbersome algorithm and low accuracy, which has a great impact on user experience. LSTM algorithm is an effective neural network algorithm, which can improve the personalized recommendation of biotechnology teaching. In this paper, LSTM algorithm is used to improve the personalized recommendation of biotechnology teaching. Finally, through experiments, the algorithm greatly reduces the complexity of personalized recommendation in biotechnology teaching, improves the accuracy rate up to 97.89%, and finally improves the user experience satisfaction.

articleTitle: Studies on Artificial Intelligence Technology's Use in Computer Network Upkeep and Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The study of Artificial Intelligence Techniques in Computer Network Operations and Maintenance aims to explore how advanced AI methods and techniques can be utilised to improve network performance, efficiency of management and maintenance, and reliability. This area of research is of increasing interest as the complexity and size of networks continues to grow, requiring smarter, automated solutions to meet changing demands. Artificial intelligence techniques can be used to monitor network performance metrics in real time and automatically detect and alert on abnormal events. Machine learning and time series analysis methods are widely used to detect network performance anomalies, thus helping operations staff identify and resolve problems more quickly. Artificial intelligence techniques can be used to automate network configuration, troubleshooting and resource optimisation. Automated network management systems can dynamically adjust network parameters according to real-time demand, improving network adaptability and flexibility. Using machine learning and data mining technologies, network equipment failures or performance degradation can be predicted so that maintenance measures can be taken in advance to reduce unnecessary downtime. Artificial intelligence technology also plays an important role in the field of network security. It can be used to detect network intrusion, threat analysis and malware detection to improve network security and protect user data. In conclusion, the use of AI technology in computer network operations and maintenance provides more intelligent and automated tools for network management and maintenance, helping to improve network performance, reduce failures and improve security. Ongoing developments in this area will continue to drive innovation in network operations and maintenance, providing more reliable network services to a variety of industries and organisations.

articleTitle: Research on AI-Based Oil and Gas Pipeline Leak Detection and Localization Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Oil and gas pipelines, as a crucial part of the global energy transmission, play an essential role in ensuring energy security and efficient transportation. However, pipeline leakage is a significant problem that has long plagued the industry, causing not only severe environmental damage but also potentially leading to major safety incidents and resulting in enormous economic losses. Traditional leakage detection methods, such as those based on pressure and flow monitoring, although effective in some cases, are often limited by high false alarm rates and low sensitivity, especially in detecting small-scale or concealed leaks.In recent years, with the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, its application in oil and gas pipeline leak detection and localization has increasingly gained attention. Artificial intelligence technologies, particularly machine learning and deep learning algorithms, can identify subtle signs of leaks by analyzing large amounts of data, thereby enabling earlier warnings of leaks. These technologies can improve the accuracy and efficiency of detection while reducing false alarm rates, offering a new perspective and method for the safe operation of pipelines.This paper aims to explore and analyze the application of artificial intelligence technology in the field of oil and gas pipeline leak detection and localization. We will first analyze the impact of oil and gas pipeline leaks, then review the limitations of traditional detection technologies, and discuss in detail how artificial intelligence can improve existing leak detection methods. Through specific case studies and analysis of experimental data, this paper will demonstrate the significant advantages of artificial intelligence technology in enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of leak detection. Finally, we will discuss the current challenges and potential directions for future development, emphasizing the importance of further research.

articleTitle: Research on High Speed Rail Transit Planning Method Based on Pyramid Multiscale Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Due to the difficulties in obtaining data and obvious subjective components in high-speed rail transit planning methods, the accessibility of planning results is poor. Therefore, a high-speed rail transit planning method based on pyramid multi-scale fusion is studied. After extracting feature data related to high-speed rail transit planning at different scales, the pyramid multi-scale fusion method is used to fuse the feature data, construct a high-speed rail transit planning model, and input the fused features to obtain the optimal high-speed rail transit planning scheme. The experimental results show that the global integration degree of the high-speed rail transit scheme planned by the design method is 0.9147, and the accessibility of the planning results is high.

articleTitle: Analysis on Whether the Wage Changes of Men and Women have Narrowed based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: This study extensively examined the wage dynamics for men and women over the period from 2011 to 2021 through data mining and regression analysis. Despite a decade passing, the study revealed a persistent and significant correlation between wages and gender. The analysis, however, has a limitation, as the models could only account for 26% of wage changes, suggesting potential missing variables such as socio-economic status, prior work experience, education, and asset status. Special attention was given to assessing whether the gender wage gap narrowed during the study period by examining the relative position and slope of the regression line. Leveraging big data and advanced analytical techniques, the study aims to comprehensively understand the intricacies of wage fluctuations between genders, offering a more scientific approach towards achieving gender equality. The inclusion of additional explanatory variables and gender-related data will enhance the analysis of the 2011 to 2021 data, providing insights into the intricate relationship between wages and gender.

articleTitle: Application of Traffic Forwarding and P2P Technology in Remote Experiment and Office in Universities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: In the scientific research work of universities, the demand of teachers and graduate students for remote experiment and office is becoming more and more common. The third-party remote control services currently used by most teachers and students have risks such as traffic leakage, so it is necessary to build a stable and secure remote access scheme. This paper mainly designs and implements a remote control service based on the Microsoft RDP protocol through traffic forwarding and P2P technology. Through the deployment of this service, the network traffic of teachers and students when conducting remote experiment and office is no longer restricted by third-party providers, which greatly improves information security.

articleTitle: Development of Preschool Science Software Based on box2d Engine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: With the development of network technology, people’s access to information is more convenient. On the Internet, the acquisition of preschool science knowledge is becoming more and more convenient. Through search engines, it can find the content of preschool science. However, due to the lack of professional knowledge, preschool science knowledge is still in a simple and one-sided state. There is a lack of teaching content suitable for children’s understanding and cognitive characteristics in early childhood science teaching, so it is particularly important to develop a scientific software that can combine children’s actual characteristics and facilitate understanding and cognition. This paper developed a preschool science software based on box2d engine, so that children can learn and explore scientific knowledge through learning and understanding, so as to stimulate their interest in scientific knowledge. Through the observation of children using the software and the analysis of the collected data, it is found that children are excited and curious about the physical simulation achieved by box2d engine, and can actively participate in learning activities. The research in this paper also provides useful guidance for the improvement and optimization of the software.

articleTitle: Study on the Factors of Sports Fatigue Based on Statistics and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Addressing the theoretical and fragmented issues in the study of factors influencing sports fatigue, this research adopts a combination of questionnaire and text mining methods as the research strategy, to comprehensively investigate the factors affecting sports fatigue. Firstly, independent variables such as types of sports, intensity, and duration were designed, and SPSS statistical software was used to perform correlation and regression analyses on the questionnaire data. The results showed a significant positive correlation between the duration and intensity of sports and the sense of fatigue. In addition, a text dataset containing 500 related literature pieces was collected, and a BERT-based neural network model was utilized for theme extraction and keyword mining analysis. It was frequently found in the texts that both nutrition supplementation and psychological adjustment are important. Combining the results of the two research methods, sports fatigue is the result of multiple factors. Intensity and duration of exercise are direct causes, while nutrition and psychology also have significant impacts. This study validates that combining tabulation and text mining methods can achieve a more comprehensive and systematic targeted research, providing a theoretical basis for the rational formulation of scientific training programs.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of High-Speed Rail Operation Speed on Passenger Traffic Based on the Least Squares Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Nowadays, China's high-speed railway has become one of the most developed high-speed railway networks in the world and is an important part of China's modern transport infrastructure. Therefore, it is particularly important to deeply analyse the historical development of high-speed railway and predict the future development trend of high-speed railway. articleTitle: Personalized Recommendation of Education Resources of Ancient Literature Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: In the digital era, the number of educational resources is rapidly increasing, and the problem faced by learners is how to efficiently obtain ancient literature education resources that meet their own needs. The abundance and uneven quality of educational resources have led to low learning efficiency for learners. Through personalized recommendations, a large number of ancient literary education resources have been accurately recommended to learners, which can help them obtain the necessary resources more efficiently and improve learning efficiency. The collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on Knowledge Graph (KG) can extract association information between knowledge entities from existing knowledge graphs. The combination of user interests and factors such as similarity and correlation between resources has provided learners with learning resources, making the recommended teaching resources more suitable for their learning needs from shallow to deep layers. The experimental results of this article indicated that the proportion of resources recommended by traditional methods that fully meet the needs was 11.5%, while the proportion of resources recommended by knowledge graphs that fully meet the needs was 38.2%. The conclusion indicates that knowledge graphs can recommend more accurate learning resources for students.

articleTitle: Multimodal Data Fusion Method for Music Education Evaluation: Comprehensive Application of Image Processing and Audio Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The traditional music assessment method is limited to a single data source, and it is difficult to evaluate students’ music performance comprehensively. To solve this problem, this study adopted the method of multi-modal data fusion, combining audio and image data for evaluation, to provide a more comprehensive music education evaluation method. Specific steps include: firstly, multimodal data was collected, including audio and images, and the collected data was preprocessed for denoising, standardization, and alignment. Secondly, relevant features were extracted from audio and image data. Then, convolutional neural network (CNN) was used to process image data; recurrent neural network (RNN) was used to process audio data, and their outputs were connected together. Multimodal Transformers were used to construct evaluation models, which were predicted and analyzed based on the input of multimodal data. Finally, the accuracy and effectiveness of the model were evaluated and optimized. The experimental results showed that the accuracy of the model optimized by hyperparameters reached 0.99, and the proposed method could effectively improve the quality of music education evaluation and comprehensively reflect students’ music performance.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Big Data Technology in Enterprise Financial Intelligent ERP System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: This paper proposes an intelligent ERP system based on big data. Each unit of the system contains functions such as demand unit, performance unit, procurement unit, and financial unit. The performance management unit includes three main functions: target management, budget management and business integration. This module can be used to complete enterprise planning, adjustment, inquiry and control. The balance of the enterprise account, the general ledger of the enterprise and the integration of intra-enterprise transactions, the indicators of each sub-account are completed by the enterprise consolidation unit. The simulation results show that the system has good scalability, flexible architecture and high security.

articleTitle: R&D of Single-Chip Microcomputer Automatic Control System Based on AI Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: With the rapid development of the economy and industrial production, industrial automation technology continues to improve, and the application of single-chip microcomputer automatic control systems in the industrial field is also becoming more and more widespread. The application of a single-chip microcomputer automatic control system can achieve automated control of industrial production processes and equipment, improve production efficiency and product quality, and reduce costs. However, there are still problems in current industrial production, such as low efficiency in factories and inability to fully complete production tasks according to requirements, which need to be further addressed. Therefore, this article studied the application of AI (artificial intelligent) technology in single-chip microcomputer automatic control systems and evaluated the production efficiency based on AI technology through data analysis. The research results indicate that compared to traditional single-chip microcomputer automatic control systems, AI technology based single-chip microcomputer automatic control systems have higher production efficiency and can better adapt to different environments, thus making adjustments and improving production efficiency.

articleTitle: Financial Risk Assessment Model of Enterprises Based on Geometric Deep Learning (GDL)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Geometric Deep Learning (GDL) is a technique for deep learning using graph-structured data that has demonstrated strong application potential in several fields. Corporate financial risk assessment is a crucial part of enterprise management. Traditional models are usually based on structured data, but it is often difficult to capture complex non-linear relationships and underlying structural information. GDL is used to better process unstructured financial data, extract potential information hidden in data, improve the accuracy of financial risk assessment, and reduce misjudgments and omissions. GDL takes financial indicators as nodes, builds a connection relationship according to the correlation, and combines the characteristics of nodes with those of their surrounding nodes. This can result in a more feature representation, input the company’s financial data, and output the company’s financial risk assessment results. The average accuracy of liquidity risk assessment based on GDL was 31.2% higher than the average accuracy of liquidity risk assessment based on the rule of thumb method, and GDL helped to improve the accuracy of financial risk prediction and assess the risk level of the company more accurately.

articleTitle: Hierarchical ST-CEN with Dynamic Attention Mechanisms for Enhanced Deepfake Image Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The increasing complexity of deepfake technologies necessitates the development of detection methods to counter their harmful propagation. This research introduces a ground-breaking approach, to detecting deepfake images by utilizing Hierarchical Spatial Temporal Contextual Embedding Networks (HST CEN) in combination with Dynamic Attention Mechanisms (DAM).By addressing the challenges in understanding temporal context within deepfake images HST CEN incorporates multi level contextual embeddings that capture subtle spatial and temporal cues. At the time DAM employs evolving attention mechanisms that hierarchically identify important features at multiple levels enabling robust detection of manipulated imagery.The methodology includes an evaluation on the ForgeryNet dataset showcasing the superiority of the model in discerning deepfake images compared to architectures. The results demonstrate performance leading to improved accuracy, specificity and generalization across various forgery techniques and different identity contexts. The qualitative analysis reveals attention value distributions providing insights into how the model identifies manipulated features for nuanced analysis, by end users. The impacts of this detection method have implications, in scenarios providing a strong defense against the spread of sophisticated deepfake content. The suggested HST CEN with DAM not enhances the capabilities of identifying manipulated images but also highlights the importance of having a deep understanding of spatial temporal context and utilizing dynamic attention mechanisms to combat the widespread use of artificially created visuals, in todays digital world.

articleTitle: Analysis of Pricing Strategies of E-commercial Agricultural Product and Effects of Promotional Activities Marketing Based on Data Mining Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of mobile internet infrastructure and related technologies, the e-commerce of agricultural product, which combines convenience and security, has made significant progress. This study delves into the application of data mining techniques in the agricultural product e-commerce sector and their impact on market strategies. Analysing various data sources such as online transaction records, user behaviour data, and social media feedback, the research highlights the crucial role of data mining in optimizing product pricing strategies, enhancing customer satisfaction, and bolstering marketing effectiveness. The experimental results reveal significant growth in product sales, particularly in new user growth rates and repeat purchase rates. Additionally, an increase in social media interaction rates underscores the importance of digital marketing in enhancing brand visibility and customer relationship building. The findings demonstrate that data mining not only aids agricultural product e-commerce platforms in gaining a deeper understanding of market dynamics and consumer needs but also facilitates the development of more personalized and targeted marketing strategies. Furthermore, data-driven strategies are essential for improving operational efficiency and fostering business growth.

articleTitle: Personalized Guidance of Big Data Analysis in College English Listening Training
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Listening is the foundation of English language understanding. There are significant differences in the English listening proficiency of college students, and their learning styles and interests vary. In terms of listening proficiency, some students may have strong listening comprehension abilities, while others may have poor comprehension abilities. In terms of learning style and interests, some students prefer to learn through listening to audio, while others may prefer to learn through reading. Personalized guidance can tailor listening training programs based on students’ learning styles and interests. Currently, it is difficult to provide personalized guidance for college English listening training based on individual differences among students. In order to enhance the personalized level of listening training guidance and improve students’ listening learning level and quality, this article combined big data analysis technology to conduct in-depth research on personalized guidance in college English listening training. This article first collected and processed data on students’ listening learning behavior, and then classified the student sample objects using decision tree algorithm to extract the features of listening learning behavior data. Finally, based on the evaluation of students’ abilities, the big data search method was applied to the teaching strategy rule library to search for teaching strategies that match students’ state parameters, achieving personalized guidance for college English listening training. To verify the effectiveness of big data analysis, this article took 102 sophomore computer science students from a certain university as the sample object, conducted personalized guidance practices in listening evaluation and student satisfaction, and compared them with traditional teaching guidance methods. The results showed that the personalized guidance method for college English listening training based on big data analysis technology showed a very satisfactory and total satisfactory increase of 21%, 19%, and 27% in terms of adaptability, personalization, and application effectiveness, respectively. The conclusion indicates that the personalized guidance of big data analysis in college English listening training can help meet students’ personalized needs and improve their listening learning level.

articleTitle: Construction of Immersive Learning Environment for College English Speaking Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Spoken English is an important component of English learning. The traditional oral learning environment is limited by time and space, making it difficult to provide good objective conditions for students’ oral learning. Traditional oral learning is limited by venues and resources, making it difficult to provide diverse contextual changes, and there are certain shortcomings in providing realism, personalization, interactivity, real-time feedback, and other aspects. In order to improve students’ oral learning level and enrich oral learning resources, this article combined virtual reality (VR) technology to conduct in-depth research on the construction of an immersive learning environment for college English oral communication. This article first determined the goals of college English oral education, and then used VR technology to design scene organization, scenario design, and interaction design, achieving the construction of an immersive learning environment for college English oral education. To verify the effectiveness of immersive learning environment for college English oral communication based on VR technology, this article took first-year students majoring in marketing from a certain university as a sample and conducted learning practice on them. The results showed that compared to students who learned oral English in traditional classroom environments, students who learned oral English in an immersive learning environment based on VR technology achieved an average increase of 3.33 points in oral expression, 1.31 points in vocabulary and grammar, and 1.81 points in English language and cultural awareness test results. The conclusion indicates that an immersive learning environment for college English oral communication based on VR technology can help improve students’ oral learning level and provide a new perspective for college English oral communication learning.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Academic Demands on Depression of High School Students Based on Machine Learning and Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: This study examines the impact of academic demands on depressive symptoms among high school students. To this end, we collected a sample dataset of 1303 questionnaires modeling the relationship between academic demands and depressive symptoms among high school students. By applying a random forest model, we performed an in-depth predictive analysis on the data. To better understand the main structure and characteristics of the data, we also performed principal component analysis (PCA). Preliminary results showed significant relationships between academic stress, test scores and family support and depressive symptoms. This study not only provides a new perspective for understanding the impact of academic demands on adolescent mental health, but also demonstrates the application potential of machine learning and statistical methods in psychological research.

articleTitle: Application and Practice of Stata Statistical Software in the Teaching of Finance Courses
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Finance is a compulsory basic course for finance students. At present, students have the following problems when studying Finance: insufficient knowledge transfer ability, insufficient attention to practical problems, "test-oriented" learning mode, and weak scientific research ability. In order to improve the quality of classroom teaching of Finance, in order to enhance students' subjective initiative in learning and ability to solve practical problems. This paper combines the application of Stata statistical software with classroom teaching to analyze real-world problems. Taking 2010-2020 as the time window, the data of 31 provinces and regions in China were selected, and the impact of traditional finance and digital finance on economic development was explored considering regional heterogeneity. Students have a deeper knowledge and understanding of the textbook "Chapter 18 Financial Development and Economic Growth". The integration of statistical software into the teaching of professional courses helps to make abstract problems concrete and realistic, then guide students to apply what they have learned. It provides useful reference for how to improve the teaching quality of professional courses.

articleTitle: Impact Diffusion Among Cybersecurity Providers: Insights from Malware Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Within this scholarly article, I investigate the diffusion of impact among diverse cybersecurity solution providers, utilizing the expansive collection of real-world malware samples within the VirusTotal database. Our rigorous examination not only substantiates a range of hypotheses and conventional suppositions but also uncovers surprising and noteworthy revelations regarding the landscape of anti-malware systems. The implications of our discoveries stretch toward steering forthcoming research pathways and furnishing invaluable assistance to both cyber-defense product creators and ordinary users in their ongoing combat against malicious software.

articleTitle: Enhanced Fog-based Smart Parking System with 5G
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The rapid growth of population and urbanization leads to substantial growth in vehicular traffic. Most city planning authorities focus on smart parking systems to automate vehicle parking and reduce traffic congestion. Thus, the smart city and Internet of Things (IoT) data traffic is growing tremendously. Moreover, cloud and fog computing are becoming well-known for IoT traffic. As a result, the cloud becomes congested. To manage parking system communication, we proposed an efficient fog-based parking system with 5G wireless communication technology to allow low latency and green communication, reduce overloading, and make faster real-time computation. Each parking lot is connected with fog nodes, Road Side Units (RSU), cloud through 5G base station, and capillary connections (Wi-Fi, ZigBee) for parking-related services like vacant parking space searching, best possible slot allocation, parking slot reservation and nearest optimal parking lot identification concerning driver’s destination location and preferences. Overall service delay, possible slot vacancies prediction, and parking cost estimation are three significant issues in this article. We simulated and compared the response time of the proposed model with the legacy models. The simulation results show the benefits of using fog computing over the cloud.

articleTitle: Internet of Medical Things: A revolution in cardiovascular disease Prevalence and Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Healthcare is an essential discipline with continuous and sustainable developments from decades in industry. Due to expeditious technological advancement in engineering the healthcare can’t be imagined without technologies like AI, Internet-Of-Things, Data Analytics etc., for quality diagnosis/prognosis on early stages of any health issues. The prominent technology Internet Of Things spreading its feet and exploring new dimensions in healthcare sector to make the digital-health possible, with the benefits of above-mentioned technologies for the improvement of healthcare services to possible consumers. The paper is focused especially on Internet of Medical Things, its applications, services more specifically for cardiology domain of medical sciences towards best medical practices.

articleTitle: Hybrid Population Intelligence and Deep Learning Research for Software Defect Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The goal of this project is to explore the topic of software defect prediction and provide a novel method for enhancing prediction model performance by fusing hybrid crowd intelligence with deep learning. In the study, we first use deep learning autoencoder for data dimensionality reduction, and achieve supervised pre-training of high-dimensional data by learning the intrinsic features of the data. Then, a deep neural network-based software defect prediction model was constructed, in which a hybrid population intelligence algorithm was used for hyperparameter optimisation. The hybrid algorithm combines the advantages of particle swarm optimisation and wolf pack algorithms for better global exploration and local optimisation when searching the hyperparameter space. In our experiments, we used a software defect dataset containing 58 features and compared the performance of five hyperparameter optimisation methods such as grid algorithm, stochastic algorithm, particle swarm algorithm, wolf pack algorithm and hybrid wolf pack algorithm. The experimental results show that the model using the hybrid wolfpack algorithm exhibits significant advantages in four evaluation metrics, including precision, recall, F-measure and AUC, and achieves more robust software defect prediction compared to other methods. This study not only promotes the application of deep learning in the field of software engineering, but also provides new empirical support for the effectiveness of group intelligence algorithms in software defect prediction.

articleTitle: Flexible and Reliable Networking Technology for WSNs in Power Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: This article provides an overview of flexible networking technology and reliable networking technology and explores their applications in power transmission WSN. Through research, a communication protocol and algorithm for resisting electromagnetic interference are proposed to ensure the reliability of wireless communication in interference environments. Simultaneously constructing routing algorithms with fault tolerance and redundancy mechanisms to improve the reliability of data transmission. This has formed a flexible and reliable networking technology suitable for the WSN (WSN) of power transmission, ensuring the stable operation of the network in various environments and interferences, and providing strong support for the safety monitoring of power transmission systems. Simulation experiments show that the communication reliability of the anti-electromagnetic interference communication protocol in this article has been improved by more than 10% compared to traditional protocols. Moreover, the anti-electromagnetic interference communication protocol can achieve a success rate of up to 95% in data packet transmission, and it also saves about 20% energy consumption compared to traditional methods. The proposed algorithm provides strong support for the stable operation of transmission and transformation WSN in complex environments. The research in this article not only helps to improve the monitoring level of power transmission systems and the stable operation of power systems, but also promotes the further improvement and application expansion of WSN technology, which has important theoretical significance and practical value.

articleTitle: Digital Economy Market Prediction and Trend Analysis Algorithms with Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: The digital economy market includes e-commerce, Internet finance, digital entertainment and other fields. Its operation is complex and changes rapidly, and traditional market analysis methods can no longer meet the needs. Big data analysis has become an important tool and method in the research of digital economy market. This paper used big data analysis to forecast and analyze the trend of digital economy market. GBDT (Gradient Boosting Decision Tree) algorithm adopts an iterative approach. Each iteration would fit a weak classifier and optimize the loss function through gradient descent to gradually improve the prediction effect of the model. The maximum prediction error of decision tree algorithm was more than 0.3, and the maximum prediction error of GBDT algorithm was less than 0.2. The results of this paper can provide accurate and comprehensive market information, provide scientific basis for decision makers, and promote the healthy development of digital economy. By forecasting and analyzing the market trend and demand, this paper can optimize the allocation of resources, improve the utilization efficiency of social resources, and promote the development of the digital economy industry.

articleTitle: Next-Gen AI in Medicine: Pioneering Brain Tumor Detection with Adaptive CNNs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: Detecting brain tumors, in diagnostics remains a challenge due to their complexity and the need for accurate and timely identification. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have proven to be tools in analyzing images showing impressive capabilities in recognizing patterns and classifying data. This research introduces an approach that combines a brain tumor detection model based on CNNs with a user Graphical User Interface (GUI) making it more accessible and easy to use. The proposed system leverages the strengths of CNNs to analyze images with a focus on detecting brain tumors. By integrating a GUI this system allows clinicians and researchers to interact intuitively input data efficiently train the model effectively and test its performance in time. The key findings of this study highlight the accuracy of the CNN architecture in detecting brain tumors within images. Moreover the inclusion of the GUI significantly enhances user experience by providing an interface for importing data, training models and conducting testing. This research contributes towards demonstrating how CNN based systems integrated with GUIs have the potential to revolutionize medical image analysis. The development of an robust tool for detecting brain tumors signifies progress, towards automating processes and improving decision making in healthcare settings.

articleTitle: Impact of Carbon Emission on Apparel and Textile Stock Returns: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: In this research, we construct a carbon emission factor(CEF) using the carbon emission price data from China’s four major carbon trading exchanges. Then, we investigate the nuanced relationship between CEF and stock returns across diverse corporate realms, from textilefirms to carbon-intensive sectors and a broader corporate landscape. Our findings consistently highlight the market’s dominant role in shaping stock returns across all sectors studied. Interestingly, while the size effect is palpable in the textile and broad corporate samples, it’s less pronounced within carbon-intensive industries. Moreover, carbon emissions’ influence on stock returns emerges as sector specific, particularly significant within textile and carbon-intensive domains. Leveraging the Dynamic Conditional Correlation (DCC) GARCH(1,1) model, we further explore the link between CEF’s logarithmic returns and the Greenhouse Gas Search Index (GSI). The results unveil the profound impact of past shocks on present-day volatility in the CEF and the historical rootedness of the GSI’s long-term volatility. Additionally, by evaluating the "CSI Mainland New Energy Theme Index" and the "CSI Green Energy Index", we discern the interconnected dynamics between CEF and the energy sector. Our comprehensive study underscores the intricate interplay between carbon pricing, public sentiment, and industry specific stock returns, offering valuable insights for stakeholders and informing climate change policy discussions.

articleTitle: Voice Recognition and Expression Research in Oral English Teaching of College English
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Communication & Convergence (ICI3C)
abstract: At present, most of college oral English teaching focuses on the study of words and grammar. There are only some oral English learning software, whose function is relatively simple, and it is difficult for learners to find mistakes and correct incorrect pronunciation entirely by themselves. Through the application of speech recognition technology, it can make the pronunciation error correction function, greatly improve the efficiency of oral teaching, and would get great value. In language pronunciation learning, effective feedback is a great help to learners. This paper used speech recognition technology based on Hidden Markov Model (HMM) to score and correct students’ spoken English, and solved a series of problems in the application of speech recognition technology to spoken English learning, especially in speech error correction. The experimental results of this paper showed that after the experiment, the number of students in the control group who are very interested in oral English was 21 less than that in the experimental group. Speech recognition can provide learners with timely, accurate and objective evaluation and feedback guidance, help learners find out the differences between their own pronunciation and the standard pronunciation, correct pronunciation errors, and thus improve the efficiency of oral English learning.
